fixes.explanation: That's it. Abraham complained to Abimelech "…about a well that Abimelech’s servants had seized…" (Genesis 21:25) The servants took the well, and Abraham brought his complaint to the king. I'd guard a well like I guard the last chocolate chip in the bowl.

Exactly. Abraham says, "You are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that I dug this well." (Genesis 21:30) Seven lambs, and every one of them is a witness. Abimelech asked a simple question and got a simple answer. I've had cookie orders with less paperwork than this well.

Yes, Beersheba. The text says the place "…was called Beersheba, because it was there that the two of them swore an oath." (Genesis 21:31) The name comes from what happened right there. A name that tells you what happened on the spot? That's better than a price sticker that said 25 cents.
